description: run_pipeline's return value on any path that does not raise -- a full run is reported via successful return, not via a report object smuggled out through an exception.
signature:
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PipelineResult:
    run_id: str
    status: str
    stages_run: list[PipelineStage]
    acquisition: AcquisitionReport | None
    enrichment: EnrichmentReport | None
    analysis: AnalysisReport | None
    started_at: datetime
    finished_at: datetime
    duration_seconds: float
    error_message: str | None
docstring:
Outcome of one run_pipeline call.

Attributes:
    status: The terminal runs.status value written for this call ('succeeded', 'failed' or 'cancelled' -- run_pipeline always ends in one of these three, never 'pending' or 'running').
    stages_run: The PipelineStage members actually attempted this call, in execution order -- for a resume starting at ENRICHMENT, this excludes ACQUISITION even though the overall run has an acquisition stage from an earlier call.
    acquisition / enrichment / analysis: The stage's own report object if that stage was attempted and returned normally this call, else None. A None here does not necessarily mean failure -- it may simply mean this call's start_stage skipped it.
    duration_seconds: Wall-clock time for this call only, not the run's cumulative time across a crash and a resume.
    error_message: Populated only when status != 'succeeded', formatted per orchestration's fixed '{stage}: {ExceptionType}: {message}' convention.
postconditions: status == 'succeeded' implies error_message is None and every stage in stages_run has a non-None report
status != 'succeeded' implies error_message is not None
finished_at - started_at, in seconds, equals duration_seconds within floating-point tolerance

edge_cases.input: A resume call starting at ENRICHMENT that succeeds
edge_cases.expected_behavior: stages_run == [PipelineStage.ENRICHMENT, PipelineStage.ANALYSIS]; acquisition is None even though the run overall does have acquisition data from the original call

edge_cases.input: A run cancelled during acquisition, before enrichment ever begins
edge_cases.expected_behavior: status='cancelled'; stages_run==[PipelineStage.ACQUISITION]; acquisition is None if the stage entry point never returned normally (it raised PipelineCancelled), even though partial raw_games rows were committed

unit_tests.name: test_succeeded_result_has_no_error_message
unit_tests.description: A full successful run's PipelineResult has error_message=None and all three reports populated.
unit_tests.expected: status='succeeded', error_message is None, acquisition/enrichment/analysis all not None

unit_tests.name: test_failed_result_has_error_message_and_partial_reports
unit_tests.description: A run failing in enrichment has acquisition populated, enrichment/analysis None, and a non-None error_message.
unit_tests.expected: status='failed', acquisition is not None, enrichment is None, error_message is not None
